description: This Java source file defines the KafkaValidator class, which extends AbstractProtocolValidator to validate Kafka connection configurations, including topics, keys, partitions, and specific configs. It also provides methods for validating source and target connection parameters within a messaging system.

classes.name: KafkaValidator
classes.description: A singleton class that validates Kafka connection configurations, including topics, keys, partitions, and specific configs, and ensures connection parameters are correct for Kafka messaging.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of KafkaValidator.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the connection type, which is KAFKA.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of the Kafka connection, including URI scheme, source configs, target configs, payload mappings, and specific configs.

methods.name: validateSource
methods.description: Throws an exception as Kafka does not support sources in this context.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Validates the target address, replacing placeholders and checking topic, key, or partition validity.
